spellbook.finance/limitations: duplicate true means this exact order with these exact rows was already recorded, and nothing new was written. A retry after a timeout is safe.
Changing any row and sending the same orderRef again records a second set of copies under the same order. To fix a mistake, receive or delete the wrong copies in the SpellBook web app first.
unitPriceUsd becomes the cost basis of each copy. Pass the price the checkout showed, including nothing the customer did not pay per card.
Shipping and tax are not recorded here.
Pending copies stay out of every listing and sale path until spellbook_inventory_incoming_receive runs for this order.
binIds names the bins the copies are assigned to. Tell the person which bin to put the cards in when the package arrives.
Workspace membership is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

annotations.title: Record purchased singles on the way

description: Record single cards the customer bought on a marketplace that have not arrived yet, one row per exact printing with the quantity and the price paid per copy. Each copy is written as pending receipt under one order, so it counts as incoming and cannot be listed or sold until it is received. Returns the order's acquisitionSource, the copy count, the total cost and the bins the copies will go into. Use it right after the customer completes a marketplace checkout for singles found through spellbook_buy_targets or spellbook_singles_buylist_spreads. It never buys anything and moves no money. A card already in hand goes through spellbook_inventory_bin_ensure instead. When the package arrives, call spellbook_inventory_incoming_receive with the returned acquisitionSource.

marketplace.description: Where the order was placed. Required. Use other for any marketplace not listed.

orderRef.description: The marketplace's order number from the checkout confirmation. Required. The same order number groups every copy for receiving.

rows.description: The order's lines, one per exact printing, condition and finish. Required, at least one.

collectorNumber.description: The collector number of this exact printing. Required.

condition.description: The condition the listing was sold as. Required.

finish.description: The finish of these copies, using the values listed in this field. Required.

quantity.description: How many copies of this printing, condition and finish the order bought. Required, at least 1.

scryfallId.description: The exact printing id, from spellbook_printings_search. Required; a wrong id records the wrong card.

setCode.description: The set code of this exact printing. Required.

unitPriceUsd.description: The price paid for ONE copy in USD, as the checkout showed it. Required.

sellerName.description: The seller's store name on the marketplace, when the checkout shows one. Shown beside the order in the incoming list.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that bought the cards, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_purchase_incoming_record
